topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I got home from work, looking forward to just unwinding, and my car was gone. Not just missing from the usual spot, but completely vanished from the driveway. My mind started racing through possibilities—maybe a family member moved it without telling me, or some mechanical issue that needed immediate attention. But the more I thought about it, the more I realized something wasn't right. I checked the street, the neighbors’ driveways, even the nearby parking lots. No luck. That’s when the little orange sticker on my mailbox caught my eye. A tow notice. My heartbeat quickened as I read the details, trying to figure out how and why this happened on my own property. I need to call the tow company, but my hands are shaking as I reach for my phone.
